---
title: "How to cite"
subtitle: "Citing the website, the tools and the software of GiniUs"
---

If you use the materials, data or tools of GiniUs in your work, please cite them. Citations help us show the impact of the project.

## Website

> GiniUs (2026). *GiniUs: avoiding biases and errors in the Gini index* [website]. Research project PID2022-136235NB-I00, University of Granada. <https://jfmunozrosas.github.io/ginius/>

```bibtex
@misc{ginius_web,
  author       = {{GiniUs project}},
  title        = {{GiniUs}: avoiding biases and errors in the {Gini} index},
  year         = {2026},
  howpublished = {\url{https://jfmunozrosas.github.io/ginius/}},
  note         = {Research project PID2022-136235NB-I00, University of Granada. Accessed: YYYY-MM-DD}
}
```

When you use data from the [observatory](observatory.qmd), please also cite the original source (Eurostat, World Bank or INE), indicated under each chart.

## Interactive tools

> GiniUs (2026). *Gini index calculator* [online tool]. University of Granada. <https://jfmunozrosas.github.io/ginius/calculator.html>

> GiniUs (2026). *Missing data simulator for the Gini index* [online tool]. University of Granada. <https://jfmunozrosas.github.io/ginius/missing-data.html>

## Software

> Muñoz, J.F., Pavía, J.M., & Álvarez-Verdejo, E. (2024). *giniVarCI: Gini Indices, Variances and Confidence Intervals for Finite and Infinite Populations*. R package version 0.0.1-3. <https://doi.org/10.32614/CRAN.package.giniVarCI>

In R: `citation("giniVarCI")`.

## Publications

> Muñoz, J.F., Moya-Fernández, P.J., & Álvarez-Verdejo, E. (2025). Exploring and correcting the bias in the estimation of the Gini measure of inequality. *Sociological Methods & Research*, 54(1), 237–274. <https://doi.org/10.1177/00491241231176847>

> Muñoz, J.F., Pavía, J.M., & Álvarez-Verdejo, E. (2026). A practical guide to proper estimation and inference of the Gini index by avoiding often encountered methodological pitfalls. *Social Indicators Research*. <https://doi.org/10.1007/s11205-026-03831-x>

All the articles of the project are listed in [Publications](publications.qmd).

## Acknowledgement of funding

Works derived from the project should include: *"This work is part of the project PID2022-136235NB-I00, funded by MICIU/AEI/10.13039/501100011033 and by ERDF/EU."*

The GitHub repository of the website includes a [`CITATION.cff`](https://github.com/jfmunozrosas/ginius/blob/main/CITATION.cff) file, so GitHub shows a **"Cite this repository"** button.
